heavinessModel.formula: 0.45 × within-corpus rarity + 0.35 × token length + 0.20 × compound/hyphen complexity
heavinessModel.aggregation: mean of the heaviest 40% of tokens; shape weighting also increases with chronology
heavinessModel.purpose: Prefer compact, lexically dense late-Celan shapes without treating every long word as equally meaningful.
